SDD: specs/000-product/spec.md

stories.summary: As a campus owner I want to register a tenant and apply plan entitlements
As a campus admin I want to invite people so only authorised users join
As a campus admin I want mock billing so I can change plan without a live PSP
As platform vs campus admin I want separate consoles so tenant data stays isolated
As a user I want in-app notifications so I see events without email
As a student I want a completion certificate when I finish all lectures
As a teacher I want course analytics so I can see if the offering is working
As a learner I want course chat and Ask AI so I can get help from materials and peers
As a learner I want to search and filter the catalog so I can find a relevant course
As a student I want a progress dashboard so I can resume the right lecture
As a teacher I want to author quizzes; as a student I want to sit them and see a score
As a teacher I want written assignments; as a student I want to submit and receive a grade
As a student I want lecture notes to persist so I can resume study later
As a teacher I want to publish announcements so the cohort sees timely news
As a teacher I want a gradebook; as a student I want only my own scores
As a teacher I want due dates; as a student I want them on My learning calendar
As a user I want to register, sign in, refresh session, and sign out securely
As a signed-in user I want to maintain my profile and password
As a student I want to enrol with mock checkout so I can start learning
As an enrolled student I want to consume the curriculum and complete lectures
As a student I want a QR course pass; as a teacher I want to scan attendance
